title: WPMS/2220/2008 of CHARU CHANDRA JOSHI Vs STATE and OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 2220 of 2008
Hon'ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.

Heard Sri D.S. Patni, learned counsel for the petitioner and
Sri K.P. Upadhyaya, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel
for the State-respondents.
 By means of this writ petition, the petitioner has sought
writ in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents no. 2
and 3 to consider the allotment of vacant accommodation of Type
IV in Fansi Ka Gadhera, Nainital.
 Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the
petitioner is a senior Executive Engineer of Public Works
Department. Officers, junior to the petitioner, have been allotted
residence. Another Officer, who is posted subsequently at
Nainital, has also been provided the accommodation. However,
the petitioner is allotted an accommodation, which is not vacant
since 2007. The petitionerís case is that one accommodation of
type IV category is lying vacant and petitioner is entitled for
allotment.
 Having heard learned counsel for the parties and after
going through the papers on record, in the above circumstances,
this writ petition is summarily disposed of directing the
Allotment Committee to consider and decide the representation
of the petitioner dated 18.11.2008, copy of which is annexure 9
to the writ petition, within a period of one month from the date
certified copy of this order is produced before respondent no. 3.
(Interim Relief Application No. 8761 of 2008 also stands disposed
of).
